hero.headline: Hey there, I'm Pavel
hero.subtitle: I guide the development of digital experiences that align with business aims, positioning design as a key component of strategy and growth.

projects.title: DailyFX
projects.subtitle: Trading Analysis Platform Redesign
projects.description: A complete redesign of the DailyFX trading analysis platform, improving UX for both novice and expert traders through better data visualization, streamlined information architecture, and a cohesive design system built for scale.

projects.title: Brainly Tutoring
projects.subtitle: Live On-Demand Tutoring Sessions
projects.description: Designed the end-to-end experience for Brainly's live tutoring feature, enabling millions of students to connect with expert tutors in real-time. Led research, prototyping, and cross-functional delivery from 0 to 1.

projects.title: Storebox
projects.subtitle: First Fully Digital Self-Storage in Europe
projects.description: Led product design at Storebox — Europe's first fully digital self-storage solution. Designed the complete customer journey from discovery to booking to smart-lock access management, replacing all physical touchpoints.

projects.title: Tabata Timer
projects.subtitle: HIIT Training App
projects.description: A focused, distraction-free Tabata interval timer designed for high-intensity interval training. Built with a minimal UI that keeps athletes in flow-state, with customisable intervals and a clear visual rhythm.

experience.description: Leading product design for DailyFX, the world's most visited forex trading news and analysis portal. Responsible for the redesign of the core platform, establishing a shared design system, and mentoring a team of designers.
Designed core product features for the world's largest peer-to-peer learning community — 350M+ users globally. Led the design of live tutoring from concept through launch.
Contributed to the growth of PandaDoc's document automation platform. Focused on the document editor experience and workflow automation, improving conversion and retention.
Founded and scaled the design function at Storebox. Established the design system, brand identity, and created Europe's first fully digital self-storage customer experience.
Designed UI/UX for mobile games and interactive experiences. Built a strong foundation in user-centred design, visual communication, and real-time interface design under tight constraints.

philosophy.title: User-Centered Design
philosophy.description: Every design decision starts and ends with the user. I advocate for deep user research, empathy mapping, and continuous testing to ensure products genuinely serve people's needs — not just business assumptions.

philosophy.title: Iterative Approach
philosophy.description: Great design is never finished on the first pass. I embrace rapid prototyping and continuous iteration — shipping, learning, and refining based on real-world feedback rather than internal consensus.

philosophy.title: Interdisciplinary Collaboration
philosophy.description: Design thrives at intersections. I work closely with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to build solutions that are technically feasible, commercially viable, and delightful to use.

philosophy.title: Data-Driven Decisions
philosophy.description: Intuition is a starting point, not an endpoint. I combine qualitative insights with quantitative data to validate assumptions and measure the real impact of design on people and business outcomes.

about.bio: I'm a digital product designer and leader based in Krakow, Poland. With over a decade of experience designing digital products, I specialise in creating experiences that balance user needs with business goals — and in building the teams and systems that make great design repeatable.
about.bio2: I've had the privilege of working with fast-growing startups and established companies across fintech, edtech, and SaaS. I believe great design is invisible — it just works.
about.bio3: Outside of work I'm drawn to typography, film photography, and long trail runs in the mountains.

contact.headline: Let's build something great together.
contact.subtext: I'm always interested in new projects, opportunities to collaborate, and conversations about design. Drop me a line — I read every message.

artifacts.title: Product Design Reading List
artifacts.description: Curated books, articles, and podcasts that have meaningfully shaped my approach to product design, leadership, and creative problem-solving.
